values.subject: Grant G-2021-0427 termination exercise statement
values.body_text: Grant ID G-2021-0427: 4,000 vested shares and 1,500 unvested shares; exercise price 29.72 CNY per share. Unvested shares stop vesting at termination. The system currently shows a 90-day post-termination exercise window for vested shares, starting the day after the last working day; the personal deadline still requires written administrator confirmation after settlement. An exercise instruction is irreversible and must be submitted by the user through the equity portal; an assistant email is not a valid instruction.
